reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Monitoring food and nutrition security and improve nutrition status of populations in Guinea-Bissau (IANDA KUME DRITU)

description.narrative: WFP proposes to deliver a technical assistance package to the Government of Guinea-Bissau aimed at achieving the following results:1)Strengthening the quality, reliability, sustainability, and use of food security, nutrition, and market price information through the establishment of an enhanced SiSSAN; 2)Increasing awareness, knowledge, and political commitment for nutrition supported by social behavioral change communication initiatives WFP will support designing a relevant and effective food security and nutrition, and market price information system with a methodological manual of key variables and indicators to monitor food insecurity; the implementation of baseline surveys; provision of data for a preparedness, mitigation and prevention; and demand driven capacity strengthening.
